subject: Gold allocation
thesis: Ray Dalio recommends 15% gold allocation. Central banks buying at highest rate since 1967. Debt/GDP at historic highs. Geopolitical fragmentation eroding dollar hegemony. Gold is insurance against regime change.

subject: Gold purchase method
thesis: Recommended IAU over GLD for Chris. Lower expense ratio (0.25% vs 0.40%), same gold exposure. For long-term holding, fee drag matters. Merrill Edge links seamlessly with BofA.

subject: Portfolio allocation framework
thesis: Recommended 30% short-term Treasuries (4%+ yield, optionality), 25% gold (hedge thesis), 25% broad index (buy weakness), 20% dividend growers (Damodaran harvesting thesis). Rationale: Market uncertain, cash not trash, diversify across asset classes.

subject: February CPI print
thesis: Expect 0.5-0.6% MoM, not 0.7%+. February caught START of energy crisis, not peak. Gas ~$2.95-3.00 in Feb vs Jan's $2.85 = ~3-5% MoM increase. Energy contribution +0.10-0.15%. Core expected ~0.3%. For >0.7% need hot core or stronger energy pass-through.

subject: Elliot CPI trade analysis
thesis: Elliot's CPI >0.7% trade at 48¢ entry. My probability estimate: 50-55% (vs his 55-60%). Still +EV at entry price but not a slam dunk. Edge reduced from 7-12pts to 2-7pts after my analysis. Hold is reasonable.
